items.title: dataarc speech synthesis SaaS platform
items.content_abstract: The DataArc Speech Recognition SaaS Platform is a deep learning-based speech-to-text cloud service. Without the need to build your own GPU infrastructure or deploy models, you can transcribe audio into text in real time or offline via standard HTTP, WebSocket, or gRPC APIs.

items.title: Mercurius Compliance Accelerator
items.content_abstract: Mercurius Compliance Accelerator is a fully managed, expert-led service that takes your organization from initial scoping to audit-ready certification and keeps you compliant year-round. Certified Mercurius specialists plan, implement and continuously operate your compliance program for ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, LGPD, NIS2 and PCI DSS. This is a human-delivered professional service, not software: we perform gap assessment, control implementation guidance, continuous control monitoring, audit preparation and ongoing advisory. Compliance-automation tooling is operated by the Mercurius team on your behalf for evidence collection; no software, license or cloud resource is delivered to the buyer through KooGallery. Outcomes: faster certification, lower internal effort and continuous, audit-ready compliance with one accountable partner.

items.title: TrueWatch Observability-License
items.content_abstract: TrueWatch offers a next-generation observability platform that unifies metrics, logs, and traces across multi-cloud environments, infrastructure, and applications. Seamlessly integrate with Huawei Cloud ecosystem like Huawei Cloud Eye, ECS, CCE, FunctionGraph, alongside five other leading cloud providers, to gain complete visibility and control over your digital ecosystem.

items.title: EspoCRM Customer Relationship Management System
items.content_abstract: EspoCRM is an open-source, private customer relationship management system that integrates modules such as customer profiles, lead tracking, sales orders, after-sales service tickets, and marketing push notifications. It supports custom fields, sales processes, and reports, with hierarchical permission controls to ensure the security of customer data. Built-in features include email integration, schedule tracking, and task reminders, providing a complete record of customer interactions across the entire process. It is designed to adapt to sales teams and small-to-medium enterprises in building a dedicated customer management platform.

items.title: Intelligent Inspection Robot
items.content_abstract: The intelligent inspection robot for high-speed EMUs independently developed by Beijing Railway Institute is an intelligent fault inspection equipment specially designed for the primary maintenance of high-speed EMUs. It adopts the mobile robot + multi-sensor fusion technology to realize fully automatic and high-precision detection of the visible components at the bottom of EMUs. Equipped with Huawei Pangu Railway CV Large Model, the robot takes AI, machine vision, multi-modal data collection and massive data deep learning as its core. It replaces the traditional manual inspection mode, solves the pain points such as low inspection efficiency, high labor intensity, heavy work pressure and reliance on experience, and provides intelligent guarantee for the safe operation of high-speed railways.

items.title: Cloud Disaster Recovery Suite
items.content_abstract: The Cloud Disaster Recovery Suite is a comprehensive solution offered by T-Systems and OnePro, integrating the functionalities of T-Systems Disaster Recovery for 25 VMs, T-Systems Cloud Engineer, and HyperBDR License. This suite provides enterprises with a holistic approach to cloud disaster recovery support and services.

items.title: Fortface
items.content_abstract: Fortface is Payface’s facial authentication solution that provides fast, secure, and frictionless identity verification. Using a simple selfie, it identifies and authenticates users in just a few seconds, with passive liveness detection that requires no movements or challenges. It features strong anti-fraud mechanisms, including protections against deepfakes and presentation attacks, certified with iBeta Level 1 and Level 2 seals (ISO/IEC 30107-3). All data complies with the LGPD, ensuring privacy and security. With selfie processing in up to 800 ms and full validation in around four seconds, it is up to three times faster than the market, achieving an approval rate close to 96%. Available as a lightweight SDK for Android, iOS, and Web, it serves multiple sectors that require reliable validation. It combines high performance, security, and easy integration for a modern and efficient authentication experience.

items.title: Redmine Project Management System
items.content_abstract: Redmine is an open-source lightweight project collaboration management platform that integrates core capabilities such as task tickets, version management, labor hour statistics, document libraries, and Gantt charts. It supports concurrent management and control of multiple projects, custom workflows and role permissions, and is suitable for R&D, administrative, and outsourcing teams. The built-in wiki knowledge base and email notifications streamline the entire process from requirement submission, progress tracking, to issue closure. It is ideal for small and medium-sized enterprises and technical teams to build their own project management platforms. (Redmine image environment, which has Redmine 5.1 pre-installed and can be deployed on cloud servers with one click. Redmine provides project management, wiki, and Git integration functions.)
